scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @workflow/api && npm run build -w @workflow/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web,smee -c gray,blue,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @workflow/shared" "npm run dev -w @workflow/api" "npm run start -w @workflow/web" "npm run smee -w @workflow/api"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
